content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied because required prior authorization was absent, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. Resubmission cannot cure the authorization defect, documentation is weak, and 0 of 11 similar appeals were paid, so another payer touch is not reasonably productive. The denial does not establish a collectible contractual patient share despite the remaining deductible, leaving the balance uncollectible.","action":"write_off"}
